book.name: HATANGA MASOK
book.title: Yesu hatanga Aposelia Yon axamandi bila mibinga. Tauxu xailongga li Yon bung ba, Hatanga Masok

content: Taguti tagangang 7, kimuama, baing long xaiya longgalo dimumguti bila auwa hataina.
Baing ngabagu Urana uleginam 7 dili maxania ba. Disina toxi tela nadi taining tainina.

Urana uleginam tela, rai bori gol tela ditau bunuxuyang saminam mana ba, ma li kabukabu hananiangamia. Disina xai susung saminam xumana na bu xaning xaung Urana lipuxing maringindi sabungadingdi, bungina hananiadi etua mana hananianga kabukabung golia wa kabukabu xaitamoxiam maxania.
Bunuxuyang saminam xaung Urana lipuxing maringindi sabungadingdi diyunga kabukabu hananiangam wa uleginama rimania saing dahaing Urana maxania.
Baing uleginama rai bori gol ba, ta yaba xap kabukabu hananiangamia ba maluxu mana laing baxagi, saing ting mari titia. Baing kaxaba taha, longa ruru, bilikbilik sabanga xaung noxiga sabanga disok.
Baing Urana uleginam 7 dituxu toxi 7 daxauxau ba diyupdi.

Uleginam mugamugangama yup toxinoa, baing kuya bila siang aisiamdi xaung yap, tang daxaning xaung sip, diting mari mana titi hataing longgalo. Baing titi hataing tela mana hataing tuwa tau masup, xai gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa tau masup xaung tatubang longgalo taudi masup.
Uleginam luwa yup toxinoa, baing axamang tela bila bimbi sabanga yaba tau mana diting mari tegia. Tek hataing tela mana hataing tuwa xugia sok sip,
axamang walingam gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa duwa tegia dimati masup, xaung waga gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa didoa masup.

Uleginam tuwa yup toxinoa, baing hatung sabanga sibuna duxu ba Mabiana ri sabalunia ma. Lu bila nagung, saing ri mana lang gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa xaung mana lang maxamaxana gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa. Binabu lang gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa dimap, saing lipu xumana dimati bungina dinung lang mabianadi ba.

Uleginam luwadi luwadi yup toxinoa, baing hanggalangiangua sok mana xaidap hataing tela mana hataing tuwa, mana sobak hataing tela mana hataing tuwa, xaung hatung gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa bu ding gugunianga tela mana hataing tuwa ding dilaba. Baing xaidaba xani xaidap hataing tela mana hataing tuwa te, saing sobaga xaung hatungdi disina yambong hataing tela mana hataing tuwa te.

Ngabagu mua baing ngalungu matikomkom tela oti liwe mana sabalunoa, wagi sabanga ba, “Laku! Laku! Laku mana lipu titiamdi namua na mauxangandi bagula xapdi bungina Urana uleginam tuwa teladi diyup toxidingdi! Tung dibo ba diyupdiuba!”
